subject: Post-demo recap: proposed volume buckets, unit economics & model routing
messages:
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightpath.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@brightpath.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:03:00Z
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: volume bands + model routing questions

Kimberly / Marissa — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap from our side and a few clarifying questions so we can lock internal budget: 

- Monthly active users (MAU) we expect: 120k in month 1, growing to ~400k by Q4.
- Per interaction avg tokens (user + assistant): ~420 tokens (chat), ~70 tokens (embedding calls for search), rerank calls are ~200 tokens on average but far fewer.
- Estimated monthly mix (very rough): chat requests 350k, embedding vectors 1.1M, rerank calls 45k.
- BrightPath target budget band for the pilot: $8k–$18k / month (we can stretch to $25k if clear ROI).
- Target unit goal: want to see a target $/1M-tokens figure to evaluate economics.

Can you confirm Redwood's recommended model split and an indicative $/1M tokens for our expected mix? Also any suggested optimizations (quantization, batch sizing, caching) that would materially move the needle on cost would be super helpful. I attached our forecast (BrightPath_forecast_May.xlsx) for reference.

Next steps: if the economics look reasonable, we want a 6-week pilot (canary) with an SLA-lite and weekly checkpoints. Can we get a short proposal and a 30-minute follow-up next week?

Thanks,
Olivia
Product Lead, BrightPath AI

--- Attachment: BrightPath_forecast_May.xlsx (spreadsheet, 78KB)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightpath.ai>; Samir Desai <samir@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T20:17:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: volume bands + model routing questions

Olivia / Samir — great to meet you both today. Appreciate the detailed forecast — that makes scoping straightforward. Below is a concise, internal-facing-style recap and our recommended starter economics and split.

Recap of your inputs (checked):
- MAU: 120k -> 400k (next 6 months)
- Avg tokens: chat ~420, embeddings ~70, rerank ~200
- Pilot target months: initial pilot 6 weeks
- Budget band: $8k–$18k (flex to $25k)

Redwood recommended starter model mix (traffic routing by intent):
- Chat (conversational UX / core prompts): 62% of token volume
- Embeddings (semantic search, embeddings-at-index-time + query-side): 30% of token volume
- Rerank (dedicated short rerank requests after recall): 8% of token volume

Unit economics (indicative, pilot config — single region US, 8-bit quantized where supported):
- Chat (gptx-small-q8 equiv): $1,050 per 1M tokens (includes average batching + KV cache savings estimate)
- Embeddings (embed-medium-q8): $210 per 1M tokens
- Rerank (rerank-compact-q4): $420 per 1M tokens

Illustrative blended target (based on your forecasted volumes):
- Estimated monthly tokens (pilot): 120M tokens total -> blended cost ~$970 per 1M tokens (blended cost = weighted avg by model token share)
- Pilot monthly cost estimate: $116k *Note: this number assumes full volume routing to the models above and no amortized reserved discounts — see options below.

Two pricing options you can pick from for the pilot: 
1) Consumption-first (no commitment): list model rates as above; predictable but higher unit price for bursty traffic.
2) Pilot reserved commit (6-week reserved capacity): commit to a small dedicated pool, ~20% lower unit cost for chat and embeddings; we can model exact savings once you confirm tokens per BTC (burst).

Optimizations that materially reduce cost:
- Prefix & KV caching for repeated contexts (can reduce chat token consumption by 10–25% depending on UX).
- Aggressive batching for long-tail bursts (configure continuous batching window during peak).
- Move rerank to a compact quantized model or hybrid pipeline (recall+cheap rerank) to cut rerank unit cost by ~30%.

Attachments: RWI_pricing_snapshot.pdf (one-page), RWI_unit_econ_calc.csv (calc tab with blended examples).

Immediate next steps I propose:
- We share a 1-page pilot economics proposal + 2 pricing options (today/tomorrow).
- Schedule a 30-minute alignment call Wednesday 11:00 AM PT to decide commitment level.
- If agreed, we spin up a pilot plan with canary routes and a shared dashboard (weekly checkpoints).

Samir / Olivia — does Wednesday 11:00 AM PT work? If not, propose two alternatives.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
--- Attachment: RWI_pricing_snapshot.pdf (pdf, 45KB)
--- Attachment: RWI_unit_econ_calc.csv (csv, 12KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T01:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: proposed volume buckets, unit economics & model routing

Kim — quick internal note before we send the final proposal to BrightPath:
- For the pilot, recommend we present two blended $/1M token scenarios (1) No-commit consumption, (2) 6-week pilot reserved with 15–22% discount on chat units. The embedding rate can be offered at a flat $170 per 1M if they commit to >1.0M embedding vectors / month (pilot scaled).
- Suggest we include a small credit (one-time $2,500) toward engineering integration if they sign the pilot within 7 days — helps convert and is typical.
- For the revised calc: tune chat unit to $950 per 1M in the reserved scenario (assumes 8-bit + moderate batching).

I'll review the RWI_unit_econ_calc.csv and drop inline numbers for the final doc. If you want, I can join the Wed call for pricing/technical Qs.

Rishi
Head of Revenue Engineering | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Desai <samir@brightpath.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>; Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: volume bands + model routing questions

Kimberly / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear options. A couple quick replies: 

- Wednesday 11:00 AM PT works for us. Confirmed.
- The reserved 6-week pilot with the blended $950–$1,050/1M chat band looks reasonable; we'd prioritize embeddings cost reduction since search is core. If you can offer the $170/1M embeddings in the reserved plan that will make the pilot approval easy.
- We accept the $2,500 integration credit contingent on a signed pilot agreement within 7 days.

Next steps for us: I will get legal to prepare a short pilot SOW and share it with Marissa by EOD Monday. Please include a one-page appendix that lists the routing policy (chat vs embeddings vs rerank), monitoring SLAs, and escalation contacts.

We look forward to the Wed call — Samir (cc'd) will join with our product ops lead.

Best,
Samir
CTO, BrightPath AI
